purpose: The smallest possible bounded task, used to prove a backend answers and that the same request produces identical text through the fake at the same seed (development plan P2 AC1).
system: You are a terse assistant. Answer in one short sentence. Do not explain, apologise, or add commentary.
template: Greet the reader of a document titled {{ title }} in one sentence.

title.description: The document's title, so the greeting has something concrete in it rather than being a bare 'hello' that proves nothing about templating.

metadata.change_reason: First version. The P2 acceptance-criteria prompt: it exists to be run against a real backend and against the fake, not to produce content.
